offer.title: Capital Markets Off-Cycle Analyst 2027
offer.description:
IK Partners is a European private equity firm investing in mid-sized companies. The Capital Markets team arranges and manages the financing behind our investments and keeps relationships with banks and debt funds.

As an off-cycle analyst you will support the team for six months on live financings, prepare lender materials and track market conditions. You will work closely with the deal teams and learn how leveraged finance is structured and negotiated.
offer.requirements:
Our expectation

  • Relevant internship experience in banking, private equity or debt advisory

  • Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills

  • Fluent English; another European language is helpful
